aplicacion.lema: Smart tourism for the Mantaro Valley Route

inicio.titulo: Discover the Mantaro Valley your way
inicio.subtitulo: Build your route around your time, your budget and what you enjoy
inicio.paso_1_texto: Your dates, your budget, your interests and the pace you want to travel at.
inicio.paso_2_texto: We suggest what to visit and in what order, with approximate times and costs.
inicio.paso_3_texto: Request lodging, transport and guides from a single place.
inicio.provincias_titulo: The four provinces of the route
inicio.aviso_datos: Academic project — catalogue data from MINCETUR; fares are estimates

catalogo.subtitulo: Tourism resources in Huancayo, Concepción, Jauja and Chupaca, taken from the official MINCETUR inventory and validated one by one.
catalogo.solo_validados: Show only resources that passed validation
catalogo.error: The catalogue could not be loaded. Is the API running?
catalogo.sin_resultados: No resource matches your search. Try removing a filter.
catalogo.aviso_mapa: {{cantidad}} resources shown on the map. Those without coordinates in the official source cannot be drawn and appear only in the list.
catalogo.sello_validado_ayuda: Has a name, a recognised district and a coordinate inside the Mantaro Valley
catalogo.sello_incompleto_ayuda: Some data is missing in the official source
catalogo.sin_coordenadas: No coordinate in the official source

detalle.sin_ubicacion: The official inventory does not record coordinates for this resource, so it cannot be placed on the map. No approximate position is assigned to it.
detalle.sin_descripcion: The official inventory does not include a description for this resource.
detalle.sello_verificado: Official data from the MINCETUR inventory · as of {{fecha}}
detalle.sello_incompleto: This resource did not pass validation: {{motivos}}

movilidad.caminando_ayuda: Short distances only, within the same district
movilidad.transporte_publico_ayuda: Minibuses and shared cars, the cheapest option

ritmo.moderado_ayuda: A balance between seeing and resting
ritmo.intenso_ayuda: Make the most of every hour

asistente.paso1_ayuda: With the dates we can tell you if there is a festival in the valley those days.
asistente.paso2_ayuda: It is the starting point of each day of the route.
asistente.distritos_del_catalogo: {{cantidad}} districts with resources in the official inventory
asistente.paso3_ayuda: For entry fees and transport, per person and for the whole trip.
asistente.presupuesto_aviso: This is a guide. Transport prices in the valley change, and are always shown with the word «approx.» and their reference date.
asistente.paso4_ayuda: Tick everything that appeals to you. You can pick several.
asistente.paso5_titulo: How do you prefer to get around?
asistente.paso5_ayuda: It determines which transfers we propose between places.
asistente.accesibilidad: I need accessibility for reduced mobility
asistente.accesibilidad_ayuda: Legs with steep slopes or without adapted access will be ruled out.
asistente.paso6_ayuda: It determines how many places fit into each day.
asistente.sin_cuenta_aviso: You do not need an account. We will save your trip and, if you want to keep it, we will offer you to sign up at the end.
asistente.error_fechas_invertidas: The end date cannot be before the start date.
asistente.error_distrito: Choose the district you are starting from.

acceso.no_hace_falta_cuenta: You do not need an account to build your trip. Sign up only if you want to save it.
acceso.error_confirmacion: The two passwords do not match.

preferencia.titulo: Now we know what you are after
preferencia.subtitulo: With this we can suggest what to visit and in what order.
preferencia.guardar_titulo: Do you want to save this trip?
preferencia.guardar_texto: Create an account and we will link it automatically. You will not have to answer the wizard again.
preferencia.proxima_fase: Personalised recommendations and the itinerary with a map arrive in the next phases of the project. For now you can explore the full catalogue.

misviajes.vacio_titulo: You have no saved trips yet
misviajes.vacio_texto: Build the first one: six questions, under two minutes.
misviajes.error: Your trips could not be loaded.
misviajes.necesitas_cuenta: Sign in to see your trips
misviajes.necesitas_cuenta_texto: This is where the trips you chose to keep are stored. You can plan one without an account and sign up at the end.

resultados.subtitulo: {{total}} resources ranked by what you told us.
resultados.error: The recommendations could not be calculated.
resultados.sin_resultados: No resource matches what you asked for. Try ticking more interests or changing how you get around.
resultados.afinidad_ayuda: How well this resource fits compared with the best match found. It is not an absolute percentage.
resultados.generado_por_modelo: Calculated with the affinity model (TF-IDF and cosine similarity)
resultados.generado_por_reglas: Calculated with the explicit rules, no model
resultados.descartados_ayuda: They are ruled out before anything is scored: without coordinates they cannot go into an itinerary, and out of your range you could not reach them.
resultados.proxima_fase: The itinerary with map, opening hours and transfer costs arrives in the next phase of the project.

itinerario.calculandoDetalle: We are computing the routes over the valley's real road network and the elevation of each leg. This takes a few seconds.
itinerario.identificadorInvalido: That preference identifier is not valid.
itinerario.errorGenerico: The itinerary could not be built.
itinerario.elegirDia: Choose the day of the trip
itinerario.soloTraslados: Transport only, no tickets or meals
itinerario.generadoPorModelo: This order was computed by the route optimiser (OR-Tools), looking for the highest-affinity combination that fits into the day and your budget.
itinerario.generadoPorReglas: This order was built with the rule-based alternative (nearest neighbour), without using the optimiser.
itinerario.sinParadas: No stops could be scheduled within the given time and budget. Try widening the hours or the budget.
itinerario.mapaVacio: Once there are stops, they will show up here on the map.
itinerario.comoReordenar: Drag a stop to change the order, or select it and use Alt + arrow up or down. Times and costs are recalculated automatically.
itinerario.errorAlReordenar: That order could not be recalculated. The times you see are from the previous order.
itinerario.tramoEstimado: Estimated leg: OpenStreetMap has no roads mapped near these points, so the distance was computed as a straight line. The real time may be longer.
itinerario.verItinerarioDetalle: Turn these recommendations into a real day, with times and costs.
itinerario.coordinarDetalle: Food, guiding, transport or lodging for this day, requested from valley providers in one place.
itinerario.valorarDetalle: Tell us how it went. Your feedback returns to the process and improves what gets recommended to others.

coordinacion.subtitulo: Request what you need from valley providers, all from one place.
coordinacion.avisoDemostracion: The providers you see are demonstration data: they do not exist. The project has no agreements with anyone in the valley yet, and their phone numbers are not real. They are here to show how coordination would work.
coordinacion.sinServicios: No services published yet for what you are looking for.
coordinacion.mensajeAyuda: Optional. Tell them anything they should know.
coordinacion.hayDisponibilidad: There is availability for that date.
coordinacion.noHayDisponibilidad: It cannot be requested like this:
coordinacion.enviada: Request sent. The provider will see it and reply.
coordinacion.errorAlEnviar: The request could not be sent.

estadoAyuda.enviada: The provider has not seen it yet.
estadoAyuda.en_revision: The provider is looking into it.

coordinacion.sinSolicitudes: You have not requested any service yet.
coordinacion.sinPermiso: This area is for providers, operators and managers. Your account does not have that role.
coordinacion.sinSesion: Sign in to open the dashboard.
coordinacion.errorAlResponder: The request could not be updated.
coordinacion.sinMisServicios: You have not published any service yet.
coordinacion.sinFichaDeProveedor: Your account has the provider role but is not linked to any provider record. Ask an administrator to link it.
coordinacion.sinDatoExplicacion: No request has been confirmed yet. An average over zero cases is not zero: it means there is no data.
coordinacion.canalesExplicacion: One: this platform. Before, it took phone, Facebook and WhatsApp, and nothing agreed was ever recorded.

valoracion.subtitulo: Your feedback returns to the process: it improves what gets recommended.
valoracion.comentarioAyuda: What you write is analysed to learn what people talk about: cleanliness, service, price, access… The original text is stored as you wrote it.
valoracion.enviada: Thank you. Your rating has been recorded.
valoracion.error: The rating could not be sent.
valoracion.sinPuntuacion: Pick how many stars before sending.
valoracion.analizadoPorModelo: Analysed with the Spanish language model.
valoracion.analizadoPorReglas: Analysed with the rule-based alternative: rating plus a word dictionary.
valoracion.tableroVacio: No ratings yet. The dashboard fills up once visitors start rating their itineraries.
valoracion.pocasValoracionesAyuda: With so few opinions, the average moves a lot with every new rating. Take it as indicative.
valoracion.loQueNoDice: What this indicator does not say

conversacion.error: Could not reach the assistant. Please try again.
conversacion.bienvenida: I can search the catalogue, recommend places and build you a one-day itinerary. Try:
conversacion.ejemplo1: What can I visit in Concepción?
conversacion.ejemplo3: I have one day in Huancayo and I am interested in handicrafts
conversacion.advertencia: I only talk about what is in MINCETUR's National Inventory of Tourism Resources. Prices are estimates, not official fares.
conversacion.noDisponible: The assistant is not available right now.
conversacion.usarFormulario: Plan your trip with the form
